entities.summary: Kamil Iskanderovich Samigullin is a Russian religious figure, acting as the mufti of the Republic of Tatarstan. He is also the chairman of the Spiritual Administration of Muslims of the Republic of Tatarstan, and a Hanafi-Maturidi scholar.
